caption: Implied timescales t_i = −τ / ln|λ_i| from the non-reversible MSM, not from VAMP singular values. Eligible processes: qwen3-8b raw and prefill (S2.2), gpt-oss-120b, glimmer T=0.3 physics. A usable model needs a flat slowest timescale. Source runs s3-dynamics-20260901T184826Z-f21d5908 and s3-dynamics-20260901T184929Z-b7c4d0c9.

limitations: 7/8 or 8/8 trajectories in the qwen and 120b cells are degenerate; a long timescale on those frames measures the loop. Reading a timescale off a VAMP singular value would be a category error. Instruct-under-P1 only (ADR-0012).
